name: Music Player
description: Control music from your chat panel. Add a named account, then sign in and start a track in its service window.
skill: Use list_accounts to discover services and saved accounts. Use add_account with service and label, optionally login=google for Spotify or YouTube Music. Then open_player with signIn=true for the first login. Google accounts play in a dedicated browser profile, where the user controls playback. Other accounts support get_playback, play and pause in the service window. Use select_account to switch. Only forget_account after the user confirms removal. Never ask for passwords or sign-in codes.
